name: Aditya Yogi
bio: Aditya Yogi founded TrendsWheel and writes most of its guides on Android, privacy and staying safe from online fraud in India. He has worked as a full stack developer for five years. He works mainly with PHP and Laravel, building SaaS products, REST APIs and business web apps, and he builds mobile apps with Flutter. His puzzle game ArrowMaze is live on Google Play.
shortBio: Full stack developer with five years in tech. Founder of TrendsWheel, writing guides on Android, privacy and online safety in India.
metaBio: Full stack developer and founder of TrendsWheel, writing step-by-step guides on Android, apps, AI tools and social media.
